verdict.rationale: Baseten documents installing a Baseten skill and official MCP servers so a coding agent can manage your Baseten workspace and search the docs. That lets you operate the platform through natural-language commands, but only via an external agent rather than a native natural-language interface. missing for 10: a native first-party natural-language console or assistant, documentation of which workspace operations the agent and MCP tools cover, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
